_comments.photon-fusion: Download Photon Fusion SDK from dashboard.photonengine.com — NOT available via Package Manager. Requires App ID. Import the .unitypackage manually after downloading.
_comments.playfab: Add PlayFab SDK via Package Manager → Add package from git URL → https://github.com/PlayFab/UnitySDK.git#master
_comments.firebase: Download Firebase Unity SDK from firebase.google.com/docs/unity/setup. Import FirebaseAnalytics.unitypackage and FirebaseCrashlytics.unitypackage only.
_comments.unity-version: Use Unity LTS — 6000.0.x (Unity 6 LTS) or latest 2022.3.x LTS at time of project creation. Pin exact version in ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt once chosen.
